status: SCHEMA FOR SCENARIO DATA ONLY. It describes the shape of a city-and-environs configuration. No rule, number, threshold, cost or outcome lives here: the engine reads this data, and the provisional playtest rules stay in strategy_game/local_slice.py. Nothing in this file is approved gameplay.
why: Issue #324 deliverable C asks for a reusable generic city-and-environs location schema plus one Ukweli configuration; strategy_game/docs/LOCAL_SLICE_RULES_PROVISIONAL.md lists 'formal scenario schema validator' as a known omission. This file and strategy_game/scenario_schema.py close that omission. The schema is deliberately country-agnostic: no Finnish or US electoral structure, geography or institution is named here.

vocabulary_is_consumed_not_restated.note: These are the four council portfolios the leader system already declares (#323). strategy_game/local_slice.py's PORTFOLIOS is the engine's copy; a test asserts the two agree rather than trusting this list.

format.note: the scenario's own format string, e.g. noopunk.strategy_game.ukweli_local

year.note: in-setting year of the starting condition

route.shape: a two-element list of location ids
route.note: an abstract adjacency, not a tactical path; direction and cost carry no meaning

what_this_schema_is_not: It is not a rule system: it validates shape, references and counts, and derives no value.
It is not canon: the Ukweli instance is scenario data, and the reuse note records which parts are recovered lore and which are newly proposed.
It does not bind the engine to one city: a second configuration conforming to this schema is a scenario, not a code change. A test proves that with a synthetic second city.
